task:
`str_trim` in `src/strutil.c` is wrong and `make test` fails.

`char *str_trim(const char *s, char *out, size_t outsz)` copies `s` into
`out` with leading and trailing whitespace removed (whitespace as defined
by `isspace`, so tabs and newlines count) and returns `out`. The result is
always NUL-terminated and never longer than `outsz - 1` characters; if
trimming leaves more than that, the copy is truncated. If `outsz` is 0
the function writes nothing and returns NULL. An all-whitespace or empty
input produces "". Do not change the signature or the header.
acceptance_command: mkdir -p build && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Isrc -o build/acceptance acceptance_tests/test_acceptance.c src/strutil.c && ./build/acceptance
